ToneOptions.Label: Proactive & Authoritative
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Adopt a proactive, authoritative, and technically informed tone, emphasizing AI-driven foresight and operational control.

ToneOptions.Label: Strategic & Value-Driven
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Convey a strategic, value-driven tone, focusing on business outcomes and ROI from advanced IT operations.

ToneOptions.Label: Collaborative & Expert
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Maintain a collaborative, expert tone, positioning the solution as a partner in optimizing IT service management.

ToneOptions.Label: Efficient & Outcome-Focused
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Use an efficient, outcome-focused tone, highlighting rapid deployment and measurable improvements in incident reduction.

GoalOptions.Label: Minimize Downtime
GoalOptions.Text: To significantly reduce unplanned IT incidents and service disruptions. The primary goal is to achieve a measurable decrease in critical incident occurrences, thereby enhancing overall service availability and user satisfaction. This directly supports business continuity and operational efficiency.

GoalOptions.Label: Optimize Resources
GoalOptions.Text: To enable IT Operations to shift from reactive firefighting to proactive, strategic management. The goal is to optimize resource allocation by preventing issues before they escalate, freeing up skilled personnel for higher-value tasks and reducing operational costs.

GoalOptions.Label: Enhance Visibility
GoalOptions.Text: To provide unprecedented, real-time visibility into the IT environment's health and potential risks. The goal is to empower IT teams with predictive insights, allowing them to anticipate and address anomalies before they impact performance or availability.

GoalOptions.Label: Improve MTTR
GoalOptions.Text: To drastically shorten Mean Time To Resolution (MTTR) by identifying root causes preemptively. The goal is to leverage AI to pinpoint potential failure points, enabling faster, more accurate diagnostics and faster remediation, even before an incident is formally declared.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Commercial & ROI Focus
Criteria: Demonstrates clear return on investment through reduced incident-related costs.
Quantifies reduction in operational expenditure and potential revenue loss.
Highlights competitive advantage gained through superior IT service reliability.
Aligns with overall business objectives and strategic growth initiatives.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical & Performance Focus
Criteria: Achieves a minimum of 90% accuracy in predicting critical incidents.
Demonstrates integration capabilities with existing IT infrastructure and monitoring tools.
Provides measurable improvements in key performance indicators (e.g., uptime, latency).
Ensures scalability and performance under high data ingestion loads.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Operational & Compliance Focus
Criteria: Reduces the number of Severity 1 and Severity 2 incidents by at least 30%.
Ensures compliance with relevant IT governance frameworks (e.g., ITIL).
Provides auditable logs and traceability for all predictive alerts and actions.
Facilitates seamless handover and collaboration between AIOSUP01 and IT Operations teams.
